description_en: Creates a resource delivery channel for the current account
description_zh: 创建当前账号资源投递渠道
name: CreateDeliveryChannel

parameters.help_en: The name of the delivery channel
parameters.name: delivery_channel_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the delivery channel
parameters.name: delivery_channel_description

fields.help_en: The delivery time. The value is in UTC and uses the `HH:mmZ` format, such as `09:00Z`
fields.help_zh: 投递时间。使用 UTC 时间，格式为 `HH:mmZ`，例如 `09:00Z`
fields.name: delivery_time

fields.help_en:
The ARN of the delivery target for oversized files.

If the size of a resource configuration change event exceeds 1 MB, the event is delivered as an OSS file. Set this parameter to the ARN of an OSS bucket whose name starts with `resourcecenter-`.

This parameter takes effect only when you create a custom scheduled resource snapshot delivery. You do not need to specify this parameter when you create a standard scheduled resource snapshot delivery
fields.help_zh:
大文件投递目标ARN。

当资源配置变更事件大小超过1MB时，将会投递为OSS文件。需要传入前缀名称为`resourcecenter-`的存储空间ARN。

该参数仅在创建自定义资源快照定时投递时生效，创建标准资源快照定时投递时，无需传入该参数
fields.name: oversized_data_oss_target_arn

fields.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the delivery target. Valid values:
If `TargetType` is set to `OSS`, set `TargetArn` to the ARN of an OSS bucket whose name starts with `resourcecenter-`. Example: `acs:oss:cn-hangzhou:191142248777****:resourcecenter-oss`.
If `TargetType` is set to `SLS`, set `TargetArn` to the ARN of a Simple Log Service Logstore whose name starts with `resourcecenter-`. Example: `acs:log:cn-hangzhou: 191142248777****:project/delivery/logstore/resourcecenter-sls`
fields.help_zh:
投递目标ARN。取值：
当指定`TargetType`为`OSS`时，`TargetArn`需传入前缀名称为`resourcecenter-`的存储空间ARN。例如：`acs:oss:cn-hangzhou:191142248777****:resourcecenter-oss`。
当指定`TargetType`为`SLS`时，`TargetArn`需传入前缀名称为`resourcecenter-`的日志库ARN。例如：`acs:log:cn-hangzhou: 191142248777****:project/delivery/logstore/resourcecenter-sls`
fields.name: target_arn

fields.help_en:
The type of the delivery target. Valid values:

For standard scheduled resource snapshot delivery, only `OSS` can be specified.

For custom scheduled resource snapshot delivery, `OSS` or `SLS` can be specified
fields.help_zh:
投递目标类型。取值：

对于标准资源快照定时投递，仅可传入`OSS`。

对于自定义资源快照定时投递，可传入`OSS`或`SLS`
fields.name: target_type
